skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Shoal Beat
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Shoal Beat. Fitness attire aimed first and foremost at the masses, absorbent and breathable, with strong stretchability. Preorder with full payment to immediately be gifted a random suitcase in a matching color.
skins.usage: One of Blue Poison's exercise outfits.
skins.quote: It means a lot to Blue Poison, just because every punch landed feeds back.

skins.name: Nocturne of Elysia
skins.content: Iteration Provident/Nocturne of Elysia. Blue Poison's iteration from decision point F/3019226. In the land of Elysia, she is the only fairy who is willing to offer a song to the toxic trees.
skins.usage: One of Blue Poison's iteration points.
skins.quote: 'Why have you come to Elysia, traveler? Do you seek a song, or perhaps an antidote for your beloved?'
